response.original_title: Asian Pacific Islander Lesbian and Bisexual Network
response.overview: The Asian and Pacific Islander Lesbian and Bisexual Women's Network (APLBN) was a coalition of individuals and groups at the local and national levels that served as a network to empower and support Asian and Pacific Islander lesbian and bisexual women (APL&Bs). APLBN was formed in 1987 after a group of activists met at the National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights. This short film highlights the history of the organization and a recruitment call for Asian and Pacific Islander lesbian and bisexual women to join the organization.
